# Shoes On: Time Blindness Coach

> Shoes On is a time blindness app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Set when you leave and it works backward, learns your real step times and tells you when to start.

## App

- [Time Blindness App | Shoes On: Time Blindness Coach](https://jackwallner.com/ios/time/index.html.md): Shoes On is a time blindness app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Set when you leave and it works backward, learns your real step times and tells you when to start.

## Guides

- [Best App for Time Blindness (2026): 5 Apps Compared](https://jackwallner.com/ios/time/best-app-for-time-blindness.html.md): The best apps for time blindness on iPhone compared: Tiimo, Routinery, Time Timer, Lately and Shoes On, for planning, routines and leaving the house on time.
- [Time Blindness: Why You're Always Late and What Helps](https://jackwallner.com/ios/time/time-blindness-always-late.html.md): Time blindness explained: why you run late even when you try, what research on the planning fallacy and ADHD timing shows, and practical steps that help.
